options.mcreflex.title: NVIDIA Reflex Tool
options.mcreflex.mode.tooltip:
Reduces system latency by dynamically pacing the game engine to eliminate GPU render queue backlog.
• On: standard low latency pacing.
• On + Boost: low latency pacing with forced max GPU core clocks.
options.mcreflex.frameLimit.tooltip: Driver-level low-latency frame limiter provided by NVIDIA Reflex. Set to 0 to disable. Recommended for G-SYNC / VRR displays (set 3-4 FPS below refresh rate).
options.mcreflex.debug.tooltip: Logs Vulkan lifecycle marker counters and latency reports to the game log every 30 frames instead of every 300 frames.
options.mcreflex.telemetry.unavailable: Reflex Status: Unavailable (Vulkan renderer or NVIDIA GPU required)
options.mcreflex.telemetry.waiting: Reflex Status: Active | Waiting for latency report...
options.mcreflex.telemetry.live: Latency: %s ms | GPU Render: %s ms | Frame #%s
